description: This file defines the ConsistencyTestGrain class, a grain implementing IConsistencyTestGrain for testing consistency in Orleans transactions. It includes nested serializable state class, methods for performing transactional reads/writes, and recursive test routines.

classes.name: ConsistencyTestGrain
classes.description: A grain class for conducting consistency tests involving transactional read/write operations and nested recursion.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Serializable class representing the transactional state with writer transaction ID and sequence number.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main method executing consistency check logic, performing recursive or transactional read/write operations based on options.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Performs a transactional read of the grain's current state, returning an array of Observation objects.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Performs a transactional update, updating writer transaction ID and sequence number, returns an array of Observation objects.

methods.name: Recurse
methods.description: Helper method performing recursive calls to simulate complex transaction scenarios with options for parallelism.
